title: Set up PostgreSQL 16 with Drizzle schema defining all 8 tenant-scoped tables
acceptance_criteria: Drizzle config file created with postgres driver connection to DATABASE_URL
Schema file defines all 8 tables: tenants, users, sessions, accounts, resumes, analyses, analysis_cache, ad_clicks
Every tenant-scoped table has UUID tenant_id column with foreign key to tenants.id
Migrations generated and runnable via `npm run db:migrate`
drizzle-orm and postgres (or pg) added to package.json dependencies
completion_summary: Installed drizzle-orm, postgres, drizzle-kit. Created schema with 9 tables (tenants, users, sessions, accounts, resumes, analyses, analysis_cache, ad_clicks, verification_tokens). Generated migration. Created seed script. Added db scripts to package.json.
